Mr.Patil, learned counsel waives service for the respondent no.5 in all petitions.
Rule is made returnable forthwith.

2. By these petitions filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioners seek a writ of mandamus for declaration that the action of the respondents of taking possession and continuing the possession of the writ property described in prayer clause (A) of the petitions is illegal and bad in law and further direction to give back the writ land to the petitioners.

3. In the alternative, the petitioners have also prayed for a writ of mandamus directing the respondent no.1 to acquire the land of the petitioners herein under the provisions of the Right to the Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013.

sentences.text: We have perused the affidavit-in-reply filed by the State Government thereby placing on record the copies of the Award Statement, copies of various notifications issued from time to time, copies of the consolidated vouchers for payments and copies of the possession receipts.
It is averred by the respondent no.2 in the affidavit- in-reply that the award is made as far back as in the year 1933.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners does not dispute this position after considering the affidavit-in-reply filed by the respondent no.2.

No affidavit-in-rejoinder is filed to the reply filed by the respondent no.2.
6.

After considering the record annexed to the affidavit-in- reply, we are of the view that the land acquisition proceedings were initiated long back, awards were made and compensation were paid to the persons entitled to such compensation.
None of the prayers in these writ petitions survives.
All the writ petitions are accordingly dismissed.
No order as to costs.

7. It is however, made clear that if any of the petitioners propose to challenge the awards by filing appropriate proceedings and if any appropriate proceedings shall be filed, same would be considered on its own merits.
M.M. SATHAYE, J. R.D. DHANUKA, J.
